delta_check: The onset of nonzero Delta is numerically close to the predicted critical threshold.
symmetry_deficit_check: The onset of nonzero symmetry deficit is numerically close to the predicted critical threshold.
lambda_check: The antisymmetric symmetric-point curvature changes sign near the predicted threshold.
scaling_check: The symmetry-deficit scaling exponent is consistent with the mean-field expectation alpha ≈ 1.
overall_assessment: The local Hessian/Landau threshold agrees with beta_c = 2/J, and in this refined two-block model the explicit symmetry deficit behaves as the primary symmetry-based observable while Delta serves as its reduced proxy. Its near-threshold scaling is also consistent with the mean-field expectation that symmetry deficit is quadratic in the order parameter.
